name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and concrete omissions. On the reviewed current runtime, supported observations include calculations, environment/editor metadata, PCB layers, loaded-view identities and bounded geometry. Attribute identity and value/placement reads retain ordered native component groups; they do not prove stored ownership. Attribute values are current model text, not necessarily raw formulas or rendered labels. Parentless String readers expose raw text and style, not rendered glyphs or font availability. Dimension geometry readers expose length/radius/angle tuples and line widths in mil. Their separate canvasUnit reflects the native current-canvas override, not verified annotation units or rendered measurements. Image readers expose IDs and bounded vector/Picture placement and dimensions, not paths, binary assets, rendered bounds or complete canvas inventory. Project-only schematic metadata readers observe one or all containers or pages without opening editors. Selected pages require their expected parent, and both complete native maps are checked before selection; no circuit, saved-membership, worker-ownership or rename authority follows. Board metadata readers return UUID, raw title, zIndex and ticket from a complete bounded native map. Their selected native equivalent requires boardUuid instead of the public method's boardName; child relationships and public object parity are excluded. Added page and board routes remain connected-unvalidated. Fill/Polyline/Region serializers remain excluded because they can rebuild native children. Current writing is narrow: forward-only name/description edits for eligible unused project-local symbols, plus separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Metadata/history prerequisites, original process ownership, full closed SQL effects and fresh saved readback remain mandatory. Historical disposable lifecycle successes do not admit another runtime or invocation. Ordinary PCB rename, referenced-symbol propagation, general schematic/PCB geometry and library writers remain disabled. Disposable schematic-container title rename has a registered original-owner forward lifecycle with aged SQL clocks, full stored effects, fresh saved metadata and child-roster verification. Connected SCH validation remains pending; ordinary-project and circuit editing stay disabled. Passive SCH phase diagnostics report the current action/phase and elapsed monotonic time plus the last attempt's duration/outcome, including pending observations and asynchronous cleanup. They grant no writer-clock or replay authority; busy with nextPhase stopped is a reserved in-flight attempt, not terminal failure. PCB text Save and compiler-publication prerequisites do not enable writing. Checkpoint verification uses authorized artifact-local scratch and final receipt freshness checks. Status includes bounded admission-scan timings without caching authority. The facade can launch the existing EasyEDA profile, open a registered disposable project, retain its original process/Job and request normal closure. Opening may migrate data, replay caches, restore tabs and automatically Save. It is not isolated or guaranteed unchanged. Close acknowledgment is not termination or saved-state proof; prompts are never answered implicitly. Lost owners, ambiguous calls and incomplete journals retain their recovery gates. Offline schemas and coverage are not execution grants. Compiled topology and affected exports remain blocked for hidden annotation or Save All. The older tuple retains separately guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. Arbitrary caller JavaScript, blind retries and unrestricted Save are unsupported. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile. Historical validation cases are in a separate optional skill reference. Consult the packaged skills and generated per-method inventory for exact contracts, remaining work and scoped validation evidence.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
